subject: Permission request: use of Acadia quote + logo in customer case study
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Atkins <jordan.atkins@acadia-systems.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Permission request: use of Acadia quote + logo in customer case study

Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for the great conversation last week. As discussed, we drafted a short one-page case study that highlights how Acadia Systems reduced inference latency and operational costs using Redwood Dedicated. We would love to publish this on our website and promote it on social (LinkedIn) with a short quote from Sanjay.

Quick asks:
- Can you confirm Acadia is comfortable with the highlighted quote ("Redwood cut our per-token inference cost by ~35% while improving 95th percentile latency")?
- Can Acadia provide the official full-color logo and any brand usage guidelines we should follow?
- If you’re comfortable, please sign a short logo/quote permission form so we can publish.

I attached the current draft and a simple permission form to make sign-off quick. If legal needs any edits we’re happy to accept redlines. If possible, could we get a reply by Monday so marketing can schedule the publish for next week?

Attachments: [draft_case_study_v1.pdf (pdf), logo_request_form.docx (docx)]

Thanks — appreciate it.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0132

From: Jordan Atkins <jordan.atkins@acadia-systems.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sanjay Mehra <sanjay.mehra@acadia-systems.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 13:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Permission request: use of Acadia quote + logo in customer case study

Hi Rishi —

Thanks for sending the draft. We like the overall tone and the call-outs on latency and cost. A couple of small points from our side:
- Please change "~35%" to "approximately 35%" in the quote. Legal prefers spelled-out wording.
- Can you remove the sentence that suggests Acadia reduced infra spend by 40% — that number came from an internal projection and we don't want it published.

I’ve attached our brand guidelines and the full-color logo (PNG). Sanjay and I are okay with the quote once the two edits above are made. We can also provide a short signed permission if your legal team needs it.

Attachments: [Acadia_brand_guidelines.pdf (pdf), Acadia_fullcolor_logo.png (image)]

Jordan Atkins
VP, Engineering
Acadia Systems
jordan.atkins@acadia-systems.com

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Atkins <jordan.atkins@acadia-systems.com>, Sanjay Mehra <sanjay.mehra@acadia-systems.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Jun 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Permission request: use of Acadia quote + logo in customer case study

Jordan / Sanjay —

Thanks for the quick response and for sending the guidelines and logo. A couple of legal clarifications before we finalize:
1) The draft references specific comparative performance numbers. We appreciate Jordan’s edit; please confirm you’re comfortable with the final phrasing: "Redwood helped us reduce per-token inference cost by approximately 35% while improving 95th percentile latency."
2) We need a short permission statement that grants Redwood non-exclusive, perpetual rights to use the quote and logo for marketing purposes. I’ve prepared a very short redline to the permission form you were sent — attached.

If you’re fine with the redline I can circulate a final PDF for signature (DocuSign). If you prefer, Jordan can reply here with approval language and we’ll attach it to the DocuSign envelope.

Attachments: [case_study_redline.docx (docx)]

Regards,
Monica Patel
Legal Counsel, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwoodinference.com

From: Jordan Atkins <jordan.atkins@acadia-systems.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sanjay Mehra <sanjay.mehra@acadia-systems.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Jun 2026 11:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Permission request: use of Acadia quote + logo in customer case study

Monica —

Thanks for the redline. Sanjay and I reviewed and we’re good to proceed with the exact language in paragraph 2 of your redline (the non-exclusive, perpetual grant).

Please find attached a signed PDF that authorizes Redwood to use the approved quote and the provided logo files in marketing materials, subject to the brand guidelines in the PDF. One note on usage: please use the full-color logo only on a white or light background; avoid stretching or altering spacing.

Attachments: [Acadia_logo_license_signed.pdf (pdf)]

Jordan Atkins
VP, Engineering, Acadia Systems

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Jun 2026 12:10:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Permission request: use of Acadia quote + logo in customer case study — approved

Laura / Marissa —

Good news: Acadia signed the permission form and sent their brand guidelines and logo. Monica confirmed the redline and Jordan confirmed the final phrasing. Next steps: 
- Laura: please pull the draft from Drive (link below), update the quote wording to "approximately 35%", remove the 40% sentence, and run final layout. Aim for a two-column PDF and a one-paragraph social quote card.
- Marissa: plan a short LinkedIn cadence (post + 1 follow-up) and add Acadia to the customer reference rotator for Q3.
- Monica: can you please upload the signed license to DocuSign and mark the record as complete?

Links: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cAcadiaCaseStudyDraft | https://app.docusign.com/Acadia/Envelope/12345

I’ll wait for Laura’s updated PDF and then we can publish. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround.

Best,
Rishi
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
